parser_notes: Real LiOH/DIW tank batching program supplied by the user. Four ladder routines under one program: R00_Main dispatches via JSR to R01_Safety, R02_Sequencer and R03_Faults. Models a realistic idle->fill->mix->transfer->fault state machine with duty/standby pump alternation (AltLiOH/AltXfr selects), a TON mix timer with .DN read, ONS start one-shot, latch/unlatch state bits, and fault aggregation. Dotted tag names (Faults.EStop, AltLiOH.SelectA) are flat tags emulating UDT/structure member access but are NOT backed by real DataType definitions. Parser grades A with 100% known-instruction coverage and 4 execution contexts (one per routine). Primary value: multi-routine/JSR program structure and a clean sequencer state machine. Note: contains NO BST/NXB/BND branch markers, so it does not exercise parallel branch logic.
